title: NBA Champion Asked If Devin Booker Gets The Assist? After Kanye West Drops Bombshell News About Chris Paul & Kim Kardashian
htmlContent:
On Thursday night before Elon Musk suspended his Twitter account, Kanye West shared that his ex-wife Kim Kardashian allegedly hooked up with Suns guard Chris Paul. When West tweeted it, of course, the tweet went viral, and Twitter is having a field day.

Former NBA vet and NBA champion with the Golden State Warriors center Andrew Bogut quote tweeted the message, "Booker with the assist?"

Booker recently broke up with Kim's younger sister Kendell Jenner, who has recently been linked to Harry Styles, but a source told E! News exclusively that the rumors about Kendall and Harry aren't true.

"She and Harry are just good friends," a separate source on Kendall's side shared with E! News. "They remained friendly over the years and have kept in touch. There's nothing romantic going on, but they do catch up from time to time and have hung out in social settings."

As for Chris Paul, he is the teammate of Devin Booker and is married, but after West put the rumor out there, Twitter believes Booker gave him an alley-oop.
